training.data: Master self-play, two players, fixed cards, automatic setup, seeds 760000-789999 (30,000 games, 436,083 afterstates)
training.targets: TD(lambda=0.7) bootstrapped from the calibrated Master score

policySourceNote: Hash of the policy source when the duel reports below were played; multiplayer.policySourceSha256 is the current source, whose duel decisions are identical (see multiplayer.duelReproduction).
policySourceHashMethod: SHA-256 over src/Risk.Sim/AI/**/*.cs, src/Risk.Sim/Learning/**/*.cs and the embedded model, sorted by repository-relative path; each file contributes its path, a NUL byte, and its bytes
evaluationSeeds: 900000-903999 (against Master), 910000-911999 (against Expert), 920000-920199 (luck analysis); played after freezing the model, and repeated once after a scoring fix that changed 10 matches; these results are the repeated run

reports.confidenceMethod: 95% Hoeffding bound over seed blocks; unfinished games count as non-wins

multiplayer.policySourceHashMethod: SHA-256 over src/Risk.Sim/AI/**/*.cs, src/Risk.Sim/Learning/**/*.cs and the embedded model, sorted by repository-relative path; each file contributes its path, a NUL byte, and its bytes
multiplayer.duelReproduction: Seeds 900000-900049 of the Master duel report above replayed with this source: 100 of 100 matches identical (frontier risk and threat weighting are scored only while more than two players remain)

probe.style: holds one continent, one border stack, one capture per turn for a card, trades every set, campaigns with the Expert planner once its army is 1.5x the strongest rival's
